The Wankipedia Method

Where Academic Rigor Meets Authentic Passion

Traditional tutoring often treats students like passive listeners. At Wankipedia, learning is an active, structured expedition guided by certified problem-solving frameworks and bespoke progress tracking.

Structured Past-Paper Mastery

Detailed, question-by-question dissection of IGCSE (Core & Extended) and Kangaroo Math competition papers with systematic marking rubrics and step-by-step scoring strategies.

Passion Project Inquiries

Students dive into self-chosen real-world domains—from aerodynamics and speedboat hydrodynamics to manga publishing economics—transforming personal interests into professional presentations.

Continuous Feedback Loop

Parents receive transparent lesson progress summaries, homework completion stats, and targeted diagnostic recommendations after every single workshop session.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about joining Wankipedia Learning Workshops.

Unlike oversized cram centers with 20+ students, our workshops strictly maintain cohorts of 1 to 4 students. We focus on conceptual derivation and method marks rather than rote memorization, ensuring students truly grasp the underlying mathematical logic and scientific principles.
Our Passion Projects allow students to explore topics they love—such as speed boat aerodynamics, Japanese manga publishing history, or aviation engineering—and turn them into objective, English-language research presentations with targeted academic vocabulary and verified data.
Yes! We offer high-definition interactive online cohorts equipped with digital whiteboard screen-sharing, collaborative note-taking, and live problem tracing for overseas or traveling students.
We maintain an automated Student Attendance & Check-in System. Parents receive post-lesson updates detailing what chapters were covered, past-paper percentage scores, homework completion rates, and next steps.
